neighbours.label: the word that introduces the second, compared term of a quantity relation: 'and other X' after a class member, 'N units of A to make one unit of B', 'replace A with B'
fire: Most of the vitamin comes from oranges and other citrus fruit rather than from supplements.
Children in the trial ate fewer sweets and other snacks than the control group.
It takes about seven kilograms of grain to produce one kilogram of beef.
Roughly two tonnes of ore are needed to yield one tonne of refined copper.
Swap the white rice with the brown variety that keeps you full for longer.
They replaced the old diesel buses with the electric models that run all day on one charge.
Farmers now lose a smaller share of their harvest to rot and other spoilage than a decade ago.
A single hive needs about two million flower visits to make one jar of honey.
quiet: Most of the vitamin comes from oranges picked in the winter months.
Children in the trial ate sweets at every meal during the first week.
The farm raises about seven hundred head of beef cattle on the lower pasture.
The mine produced refined copper for over fifty years before it closed.
Cook the white rice until it is fluffy and let it rest for ten minutes.
The old diesel buses were sold to a company in the north last year.
Farmers store their harvest in cool sheds behind the main barn.
A single hive can hold about fifty thousand bees at the height of summer.

predictions: Weak hold at best (5/8); broad pole (1.0% of tokens at 0.1 max) so near misses with plain measures may leak to 0.1-0.2.
short: second term of a quantity relation
notes: Card peaks on function words inside comparisons and conversions (milk and other dairy than, more to build than, one gallon of, substitute with). Probe: 'bread and other grains' 0.354 on ' other', 'to make one litre of' 0.288 on ' of', 'replace with' 0.250 on ' with'; 'more than the old one' only 0.092, 'list of twelve' 0.023, 'referred to as' 0.026, unrelated controls 0.012-0.015. So the 'than' comparison itself is weak; the and-other / ratio / substitution frames carry it.
